SELECT to_char(to_date(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy"年"mm"月"dd"日"') cdate, A.prodestablish,--产品成立 B.nhgexpire,--逆回购到期 C.zhgsq,--正回购首期 D.ccexpire,--拆出到期 E.crsq,--拆入首期 F.assetsale,--资产卖出 G.assetexpire,--资产到期 H.assetpayments,--资产中间收息 nvl(A.prodestablish,0)+nvl(B.nhgexpire,0)+nvl(C.zhgsq,0)+nvl(D.ccexpire,0)+nvl(E.crsq,0)+nvl(F.assetsale,0)+nvl(G.assetexpire,0)+nvl(H.assetpayments,0) calclr, I.prodexpire,--产品到期 J.nhgsq, --逆回购首期 K.zhgexpire,--正回购到期 L.ccsq,--拆出首期 M.crexpire, --拆入到期 N.assetbuy,--资产买入 nvl(I.prodexpire,0)+nvl(J.nhgsq,0)+nvl(K.zhgexpire,0)+nvl(L.ccsq,0)+nvl(M.crexpire,0)+nvl(N.assetbuy,0) calclc, (nvl(A.prodestablish,0)+nvl(B.nhgexpire,0)+nvl(C.zhgsq,0)+nvl(D.ccexpire,0)+nvl(E.crsq,0)+nvl(F.assetsale,0)+nvl(G.assetexpire,0)+nvl(H.assetpayments,0))- (nvl(I.prodexpire,0)+nvl(J.nhgsq,0)+nvl(K.zhgexpire,0)+nvl(L.ccsq,0)+nvl(M.crexpire,0)+nvl(N.assetbuy,0)) cleancashflow FROM --产品成立 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) prodestablish from detail where ps in ('C1', 'C2') and FINPROD_TYPE2 is not null) A, --逆回购到期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) nhgexpire from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F03','F05') and ps = 'T07' ) B, --正回购首期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) zhgsq from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F02','F04') and ps = 'T01' ) C, --拆出到期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) ccexpire from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F09') and ps in ('T07','T13','T22','T23') ) D, --拆入首期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) crsq from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F08','F25') and ps = 'T01' ) E, --资产卖出 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) assetsale from detail where ps in ('T02','T03','T24','T39') and FINPROD_TYPE2 is not null and TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null) F, --资产到期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) assetexpire from detail where ps in ('T07','T08','T38') and FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F02','F03','F04','F05','F09','F25','F29') ) G, --资产中间收息 (select sum(assetpayments) assetpayments from ( select sum(TRADE_AMT) assetpayments from detail where ps in ('T09','T11') union all select sum(TRADE_AMT) assetpayments from detail where ps in ('T22') and exists ( select 1 from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal where deal.ps in('T09') AND detail.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID )) ) H,
--产品到期 (select sum(SHARE_AMT) prodexpire from detail where ps in ('C5','C20') ) I, --逆回购首期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) nhgsq from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F03','F05') and ps = 'T01' ) J, --正回购到期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) zhgexpire from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F02','F04') and ps = 'T07' ) K, --拆出首期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) ccsq from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F09') and ps = 'T01' ) L, --拆入到期 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) crexpire from detail where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F25') and ps = 'T07' ) M, --资产买入 (select sum(TRADE_AMT) assetbuy from detail where ps in ('T01','T04','T46','T47','T48') and FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F02','F03','F04','F05','F08','F09','F25') and TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null) N

SELECT to_char(to_date(#{searchDateFuture,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy"年"mm"月"dd"日"') cdate, A.nhgexpire,--逆回购到期 C.ccexpire,--拆出到期 E.assetexpire,--资产到期 F.assetpayments,--资产中间收息 nvl(A.nhgexpire,0)+nvl(C.ccexpire,0)+nvl(E.assetexpire,0)+nvl(F.assetpayments,0) calclr,--现金流入-小计 G.prodexpire,--产品到期 I.zhgexpire,--正回购到期 K.crexpire,--拆入到期 nvl(G.prodexpire,0)+nvl(I.zhgexpire,0)+nvl(K.crexpire,0) calclc,--现金流出-小计 (nvl(A.nhgexpire,0)+nvl(C.ccexpire,0)+nvl(E.assetexpire,0)+nvl(F.assetpayments,0))- (nvl(G.prodexpire,0)+nvl(I.zhgexpire,0)+nvl(K.crexpire,0)) cleancashflow--净现金流 FROM --逆回购到期 (select sum(CASHFLOW) nhgexpire from DetailFuture where CASHFLOWTYPE in ('F03','F05')) A, --拆出到期 (select sum(CASHFLOW) ccexpire from DetailFuture where CASHFLOWTYPE in ('F09')) C, --资产到期 (select sum(CASHFLOW) assetexpire from DetailFuture where CASHFLOWTYPE not in ('F03', 'F05', 'F02', 'F04','F08', 'F09', 'F25') and cash_type != '01') E, --资产中间收息 (select sum(CASHFLOW) assetpayments from DetailFuture where CASHFLOWTYPE in ('F03', 'F05', 'F02', 'F04','F08', 'F09', 'F25','F01','F07','F17','F18') and cash_type = '01') F,
--产品到期 (select sum(CASHFLOW) prodexpire from DetailFuture where CASHFLOWTYPE in ('F16','F24')) G, --正回购到期 (select sum(CASHFLOW) zhgexpire from DetailFuture where CASHFLOWTYPE in ('F02', 'F04')) I, --拆入到期 (select sum(CASHFLOW) crexpire from DetailFuture where CASHFLOWTYPE in ('F08','F25')) K

select distinct product.prod_manager id,users.REAL_NAME text from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD product left join sys_user users on product.prod_manager = users.USER_NAME where prod_manager is not null
and (prod_manager like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
